title: Reorder by dragging
description:
Move list items by drag and drop, the way an ImGui drag-and-drop payload carries an index.

```
layers: Background Terrain Units Effects UI
drag "UI" onto "Terrain" -> Background UI Terrain Units Effects
drag "Background" onto itself -> no change
```
hints: `std::rotate` moves a range: moving `from` to an earlier `to` is `std::rotate(begin + to, begin + from, begin + from + 1)` (lesson 4.03).
Moving later is the mirror: `std::rotate(begin + from, begin + from + 1, begin + to + 1)` (decide whether "onto" means before or after).
requirements: The payload is the index of the dragged item; dropping on another item moves it before that item.
Keep the selection on the moved item.
stretch: Allow dragging a layer onto a "trash" target that deletes it.
